PLAN 05 | ONE GARMENT TWO MEN
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9
REFERENCE ASSIGNMENTS
CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_ARMAYIL_COOK}}
{{CHAR_GARMAYIL_COOK}}
{{CHAR_OLDER_BROTHER}}
{{CHAR_YOUNGER_BROTHER}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_PREP_ROOM}}
PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_ESCAPE_ROBE}}
Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic block with the exact timed shots below. Hard cuts occur only at the listed shot boundaries. Preserve assigned character identities, rigid handmade masks, body proportions and reference costume states. Masks remain inanimate; emotion comes through breathing, posture, hands and timing. Maintain tactile worn materials, restrained exposure and imperfect human camera balance. All performers are adults. Camera movement is physically motivated by the specified action. References anchor design; the written lighting governs illumination. No readable titles or dialogue are generated.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Hard neutral ceiling fixture over the floor, warmer work-lamp spill on the west wall. The same physical room stays dim but readable: rear north door, east/right counter, west/left wall. Fixed exposure and practical light; tension increases through stillness.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Camera south looking north. Older screen left; Younger just right of Older. Armayil center-right facing the brothers. Garmayil right beside the counter, facing left. Brothers have just released a relieved embrace. Exactly one folded escape robe rests on the right counter; it will be picked up and fully displayed.

SHOT 05A | 00s to 06s | 6 seconds
40mm medium four-person composition from south. Garmayil lifts ONE folded robe from the counter with both hands and unfolds it by its two shoulders. It is one continuous garment with one neck opening. Hold its full silhouette between the brothers at left and Garmayil at right. Older initially reaches toward it, then notices there is only one. Armayil cannot meet his gaze.
SHOT 05B | 06s to 15s | 9 seconds
65mm close two-shot from south. Older left foreground, Younger right, both facing slightly right toward the off-screen robe. Older’s reaching hand stops halfway, then drops. His expanded chest collapses slowly. Younger first looks at the garment, then turns left toward Older. Older looks between Younger and the robe; his grip tightens on Younger’s sleeve. Let several seconds pass with only breathing. End with their hands holding the same sleeve, before either offers the garment.
END STATE AND EDIT
Only one escape robe exists, still in Garmayil’s hands at screen right. Both brothers now understand that only one can leave.
SOUND
Robe unfolding, relief breath stopping, a faint lamp hum, cloth tightening. The silence is sustained without dramatic sound effects.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Enclosed preparation room with a NORTH main door, EAST work counter and WEST narrow service exit. START STATE AND BLOCKING
Older left and Younger right embrace at center. Armayil left/west watches them and listens toward the shut north door. Garmayil right/east stands beside the ONE escape robe already unfolded on the counter. Camera starts south-center and stays south of the brothers-to-counter axis.


SHOT 05A | 0s to 3s | 3 seconds
35mm close handheld at the brothers’ shoulder height. Their embrace remains tight. Camera takes a short rightward step around the near side of Younger’s shoulder, following Garmayil’s reaching hand to the east counter. Older remains left, Younger center, Garmayil right. The move is a nervous change of attention with foreground occlusion.

SHOT 05B | 3s to 5s | 2 seconds
50mm hand-and-torso detail from southeast. Garmayil immediately lifts the ready robe by its two shoulder seams. Its single neck opening and continuous garment are clearly visible. He holds it between himself at right and the brothers at left; his grip trembles slightly under urgency.

SHOT 05C | 5s to 8s | 3 seconds
65mm close from south-center on Older at left, Younger’s shoulder soft at right. Older reaches toward the garment, notices there is only one, stops his hand and turns sharply toward Younger. SHOT 05D | 8s to 10s | 2 seconds
65mm close from south-east on Younger, facing left toward Older. He looks from the one robe at his right to his brother at left, grips Older’s sleeve and shakes his head once. The handheld camera catches his turn with a short pan.

SHOT 05F | 12s to 15s | 3 seconds
28mm tight three-person composition from south-center: Older left, Younger center, Garmayil right holding the robe. Older pushes the robe toward Younger; Younger pushes it back toward Older and clings harder. Camera makes a short lateral correction to keep their hands and masked faces together. Garmayil bends in, distressed and ready to help.

END STATE AND EDIT
Both brothers understand only one can leave. The single robe remains in Garmayil’s hands at right. Older is beginning to force the choice toward Younger; Armayil stays actively alert beside them.

SOUND
Fast clothing friction, broken breaths, a sleeve pulled tight, quiet urgent nonverbal cries and distant service-room resonance.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
